newsitem.title: UK: ECGD resumes cover for exports to Venezuela.
newsitem.headline: ECGD resumes cover for exports to Venezuela.

text.p: Britain's official export credit agency, the Export Credits Guarantee Department (ECGD), has resumed support for the export of British capital goods to Venezuela, Lord Clinton-Davis, U.K. Trade Minister said in a statement on Monday.

The decision to restore support for British exports reflects Venezuela's adoption and adherence to an IMF economic reform programme, the lifting of foreign exchange and price controls and the opening of the oil sector to foreign companies, the statement said.
"This will be welcome news for a number of British exporters who now appear to be in a good position to win valuable orders in this improving market," Lord Clinton-Davis said.
